snippet.title: History Time
snippet.description:
Travel back in time with me to some of the most fascinating moments in human history. Witness colossal sea battles involving tens of thousands of men, take part in pagan blood rituals in the mysterious forests of Northern Europe and engage in highly orchestrated tribal warfare within Pre-Columbian Mesoamerica. All this and more from the comfort of your own living room/bus to work/toilet throne.

Established in early 2017, History Time is researched, written, filmed, narrated & produced by Pete Kelly - public educator from the UK with history degrees at undergraduate and postgraduate level.

Guest writers include historians, authors and archaeologists such as Dr Raoul McLaughlin, Dr David Frye, Dr David Miano & Gordon Doherty.

Original music is composed for the channel by Joss Edwards, Brodie Marshall & Matt Hunt

No AI is used. 

Sign up to my free mailing list for adventures at the worlds greatest archaeological sites-
http://historytimewithpete.substack.com

snippet.title: Takumi Secrets
snippet.description:
Welcome to Takumi Secrets!

This channel uncovers the hidden ideas, systems, and methods behind the way Japan designs homes, infrastructure, tools, and everyday life. From construction techniques and drainage systems to space-saving designs, passive cooling methods, and long-lasting materials, each video explores practical solutions that solve real problems in ways most people never think about.

We break down how these systems work, why they are effective, and what makes them different from many modern approaches. Instead of focusing on trends or gimmicks, the videos look at the engineering, logic, and design principles that help reduce waste, improve durability, and prevent expensive failures over time.

Some of these methods are decades old. Others are still being used across Japan today. The goal of this channel is to explain the hidden thinking behind them — and show why simple, well-designed systems often outperform more complicated solutions.

snippet.title: Learning Made Fun
snippet.description:
Welcome to Learning Made Fun.

This channel started during the pandemic to stop students (and teachers) slowly losing the will to live during online learning. It turned into a mission: proving that learning doesn’t have to be boring, passive, or worksheet-shaped.

School works brilliantly for some students.
For others, not so much. Sitting still, copying notes, and being told to “focus” isn’t exactly inspiring. So we do things differently.

Here, learning is active, visual, story-driven, and connected to the real world. We focus on skills that actually matter — creativity, problem-solving, collaboration, and communication — not just memorising facts for 5 minutes.

Instead of talking about topics, we go there. Rivers. Rainforests. Deserts. Mountains. If students are learning about it, they should see it in action.

And these videos are just scratching the surface of what we do

The real projects and learning lives on the Learning Made Fun website.

Welcome aboard and have fun!

snippet.title: Historical Architect
snippet.description:
Just a guy who likes architecture and engineering. Oh and history too :)

Welcome!

On my channel, you'll discover how humans survived and thrived before modern shelter, tools, and technology. From underground pit houses to mammoth bone structures to medieval architecture, explore the incredible engineering and survival techniques our ancestors used to conquer harsh environments with nothing but stone, wood and ingenuity. 

New episodes weekly uncovering the lost arts of primitive shelter building, ancient construction techniques, and survival strategies that sustained humanity for over 99% of our history. Learn skills that could save your life and gain a new appreciation for human innovation.

#history #prehistoricarchitecture #prehistoric #discoverychannel #stoneage #paleolithic

Journey into the brutal and fascinating world of the Vikings.
Viking Age Chronicles explores the real history, battles, legends, and secrets of the Norse warriors who changed Europe forever.
Discover their strategies, voyages, myths, and the truth behind one of the most legendary civilizations in history.

snippet.title: Kings and Generals
snippet.description:
Sponsorship email: info@kingsandgenerals.net

Welcome to Kings and Generals, the premier YouTube channel for anyone interested in military history. Our channel is dedicated to providing high-quality educational content that explores some of the most significant military campaigns, battles, and strategies throughout history.
Our team of passionate historians and military experts are committed to delivering accurate and engaging content that is accessible to viewers of all levels. From the ancient world to the modern era, we cover a wide range of topics with a focus on in-depth analysis and informative discussions.
Our videos feature detailed maps, graphics, and animations that bring historical events to life and make them easier to understand. Kings and Generals is the go-to resource for anyone looking to learn more about military history.
Join our community of history enthusiasts and discover the fascinating world of military history with Kings and Generals.

snippet.title: Through the Agees
snippet.description:
Welcome to Through the Ages!
Your gateway to the story of humanity  from ancient civilizations to the modern world. We explore how societies rose, cultures evolved, and moments in history shaped the world we live in today.

Find videos on:
• The rise and fall of empires and great kingdoms
• Ancient civilizations like Egypt, Rome, Greece, and Mesopotamia
• Medieval history, dynasties, and legendary battles
• The age of exploration, invention, and revolution
• Cultural evolution, art, and traditions across time
• Forgotten events and untold stories from around the globe

Through the Ages takes you on a visual journey across centuries revealing how the past connects to the present. Join us to rediscover humanity’s greatest achievements, struggles, and transformations.

Subscribe for documentaries, cinematic timelines, and immersive stories that bring history to life!

#ThroughTheAges #HistoryChannel #AncientCivilizations #WorldHistory #Documentary

snippet.title: Chrononomics
snippet.description:
Welcome to Chrononomics – where history isn’t just told… it’s experienced.
From the whispers of ancient empires to the sparks of revolutionary moments, this channel uncovers the most fascinating stories, people, and events that shaped the world.

🕰️ What You’ll Get as a Subscriber:

Bite-sized historical documentaries with cinematic storytelling

Deep dives into famous figures, unsung heroes, and curious events

Engaging visuals, monologues, and timelines that bring the past to life

A mix of fact-based storytelling with dramatic flair and unique perspectives

Whether you’re a history lover, a curious thinker, or someone just looking for powerful stories that still echo today — Chrononomics is your portal to the past.

🔔 Subscribe and travel through time with us — one story at a time.

snippet.title: The Viking Vault
snippet.description:
Embark on a thrilling journey through time as we uncover the truth about the legendary Vikings! On this channel, we'll delve deep into the history, culture, and myths surrounding these fierce warriors who once ruled the seas. From their iconic longships and advanced navigation skills to their notorious raids and exploration feats, we'll separate fact from fiction and reveal the true story of the Vikings. 

Discover the secrets of their society, their beliefs, and the lasting impact they've had on the world. Join us as we set sail on an unforgettable adventure and bring the fascinating world of the Vikings to life. Don't miss out – hit the subscribe button and turn on notifications to stay updated on our latest historical explorations! 🗡️🛡️
